title: No suite test runs scenario_pack's check route or FRESH_CHECK: every test stubs scenario_pack
goal: An existing test of _tools/test_bench.py runs the real scenario_pack on a pack with a check: line and no route: line and asserts pool check names the row (the pack prints a check: line), and asserts bench_pool.FRESH_CHECK does not match a bare article header's retrieved date; no new test id, tests_ceiling.json untouched

run: import sys;t=open('_tools/test_bench.py',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(0 if 'FRESH_CHECK' in t and 'prints a check: line' in t else 1)

repro_reason: The defect is a missing assertion in the suite: the code works today (BG-4flop3jv and BG-chs2di4p checks), so only the test file's text can show the assertion is absent; the fix's check is python3 _tools/tests.py -k bench_pool_check_reports_stale_pick with scenario_pack reverted failing it.

run: import subprocess,sys;t=open('_tools/test_bench.py',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(1 if 'FRESH_CHECK' not in t or 'prints a check: line' not in t else subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/tests.py','-k','bench_pool_check_reports_stale_pick']).returncode)

import subprocess as s,sys,re;g=lambda *a:s.run(['git',*a],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;b=g('merge-base','HEAD','origin/main').strip();c=lambda t:len(re.findall(r'(?m)^def test_',t));sys.exit(0 if g('diff',b,'--','_tools/tests_ceiling.json')=='' and c(open('_tools/test_bench.py',encoding='utf-8').read())<=c(g('show',b+':_tools/test_bench.py')) else 1)
